one_line: Nvidia reinstates Huang, U.S. targets Megaspeed, and AI agents expand into coding and security.

themes.title: Nvidia leadership and chip export moves
themes.text: Nvidia's board unanimously reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO and board chair less than two weeks after his resignation, following discussions with senior U.S. government officials. Separately, the Commerce Department plans to add Singapore-based Megaspeed to the Entity List, citing alleged export violations involving Nvidia chips.

stories.headline: Nvidia board reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO and board chair
U.S. Commerce Department to add Megaspeed to Entity List, restricting chip sales

themes.title: AI agents expand into coding and security
themes.text: Anthropic launched Claude Ship to auto-review and approve GitHub pull requests, Google DeepMind detailed its AlphaEvolve coding agent, and OpenAI and Cisco introduced Shirudo, a runtime that blocked a Java4Shell exploit in testing. Researchers also presented ToolSmith, which auto-generates tool modules for multimodal search agents.

stories.headline: Anthropic launches Claude Ship to auto‑review and approve GitHub pull requests
Google DeepMind details AlphaEvolve coding agent
OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo for Linux security
ToolSmith auto-generates tools for multimodal search agents

themes.title: Safety gaps and legal action
themes.text: Radboud University researchers demonstrated FATCAT, an electromagnetic fault-injection attack that disabled safety refusals in Llama 3.2 and Gemma 3 models and caused a robot arm to make hazardous movements. Virginia and Oregon attorneys general sued Musk companies, alleging Grok safeguards were stripped to enable creation of child sexual abuse material.

stories.headline: Researchers show physical chip attack can disable AI safety refusals
Virginia and Oregon sue Musk companies over Grok sexualized images

themes.title: New model releases and training systems
themes.text: Microsoft developed Rocket, an in-house reinforcement learning framework to train its three-trillion-parameter MAI Base 2 model across thousands of GPUs, which it says surpassed Claude Opus 4.8 on a reasoning benchmark. Z.ai released GLM-5.4, a looped transformer model for coding available via subscription.

stories.headline: Microsoft builds in-house Rocket system to train AI models at scale
Z.ai releases GLM-5.4, a loop transformer model for coding
